scope: Source-independent AC1024 canonical-null opt-in for up to two distinct layers named 0 and Defpoints, sharing the staged Global material and one no-reactor Normal plot-style graph. Other caller profiles do not use this gate.
graphProof: Before publication, bind each selected layer handle and common plot target; check the emitted LAYER handle-tail object type, owner, H5 null xref, H5 plot-style, H5 Global material and H5 linetype, including bounded ordered bit spans. Require a typed no-reactor DICTIONARYWDFLT with exactly one Normal entry and its H2 entry/H5 default targets, a typed no-reactor ACDBPLACEHOLDER with its H4 owner, matching owner/dictionary identities and one ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME NOD root. Existing default-material graph validation verifies staged Global material and its root.
rollback: The bounded graph ledger participates in DWG compound/public transaction checkpoints. Ten controls reject missing placeholder, wrong owner, default, root, entry name, entry target, extension state, dictionary owner and inconsistent dictionary/placeholder reactor counts while preserving prior destination bytes. Two controls first emit an invalid dictionary or placeholder, then successfully retry the corrected object within the same write; a final same-facade write also succeeds.
validation: Focused AC1024 source/output binding, default-material, AC1027 compatibility, layer transaction and repeated-header controls passed; LibreCAD_3 compatibility guard compiled. GNU C++16 with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror syntax-checked the writer and test. Generated canonical DWG SHA-256 318bd94261ac17630365800d165ac58b0fb0c037e249b6c2c927d82e6188f416 is byte-identical to the prior source that ODA converted without an error file and LibreDWG independently decoded; no new DWG/DXF fixtures were committed.
limits: The caller remains responsible for opting in only newly authored layers; imported DXF layers may not carry DWG provenance. This selected graph does not establish general material rendering, plotting, other layer names, other DWG versions or complete format support. The physical-source HEADER suffix and independent verifier page-size disagreement remain open.
